whatIs.description: A custom printed lanyard is a branded neck strap used to carry an ID card, badge or other identification credential. Instead of using a plain lanyard, organizations can print their logo, name, colours or repeating branding directly onto the lanyard.

faqs.q: What type of custom printed lanyards does iDGen provide?
faqs.a: iDGen provides custom printed 20 mm satin polyester lanyards with organization branding, including logos, names, colours, text, repeating patterns and approved artwork. They can be used with student, employee, staff, membership and event identification systems.

faqs.q: What can be printed on a custom lanyard?
faqs.a: Depending on the approved artwork, a lanyard can include an organization or company logo, school or college branding, organization name, event name, department name, brand colours, sponsor logos, short text and repeating graphic patterns.

faqs.q: Can iDGen match the lanyard design to our existing branding?
faqs.a: Yes. iDGen can work with customer-supplied branding or approved artwork. The lanyard design can incorporate the organization's logo, colours, name and other approved visual elements, subject to the production requirements of the selected lanyard.

faqs.q: Can I order custom lanyards without ordering ID cards?
faqs.a: Yes. Custom printed lanyards can be ordered separately. They can be supplied for use with existing ID cards, holders or other identification accessories.

faqs.q: Can custom printed lanyards be supplied with ID cards and accessories?
faqs.a: Yes. Lanyards can be combined with ID cards, holders and hooks to create a complete wearable identification setup. For suitable configurations, iDGen can also provide ultrasonic sealing as an attachment or finishing option.

faqs.q: What attachment options are available for custom printed lanyards?
faqs.a: The appropriate attachment depends on the intended identification setup. Lanyards can be configured with suitable hooks and holders, while ultrasonic sealing can be used for selected integrated lanyard configurations. The required configuration should be confirmed before production.

faqs.q: Can organizations order custom lanyards in bulk?
faqs.a: Yes. iDGen supports bulk custom lanyard orders for schools, colleges, companies, institutions, membership programs, conferences, events and other organizations. The quotation depends on the quantity, lanyard specification, artwork and required configuration.

faqs.q: Can different lanyard designs be made for departments or groups?
faqs.a: Yes. Where required, separate approved designs can be prepared for departments, categories, organizational groups or event access levels. The final designs should be confirmed before production.

faqs.q: How does the custom lanyard artwork approval process work?
faqs.a: The process generally involves sharing the branding or artwork, confirming the lanyard specification, preparing the artwork for production, reviewing the preview and approving the final design. Production begins after the required artwork and specifications have been approved.

faqs.q: Can iDGen produce custom lanyards for events and conferences?
faqs.a: Yes. Custom printed lanyards can be produced for conferences, seminars, exhibitions, corporate programs and other events. Event names, logos, sponsor branding and other approved artwork can be incorporated into the design.

faqs.q: What information is required to get a custom lanyard quotation?
faqs.a: To prepare a quotation, provide the required quantity, lanyard specification, branding or artwork, preferred attachment configuration and intended application. If the lanyards will be supplied with ID cards or other accessories, those requirements should also be included.
